portability_note: Setup paths only changed; original GNU observations retained, not re-recorded.
isolation: one GNU process per case; idempotent fset setup between compiled/interpreted evaluation; private HOME/TMPDIR under scratch
comparison: exact full printed value or complete condition/data; candidate compiled vs GNU byte-compiled (interpreted retained, never silently substituted)
replay: one fresh candidate process per case, --gc-floor 1 --eval-stream, one source request per process; no GNU execution

limitations.vector: Vector sequence traversal / vector reader substrate is not yet exposed to Leaf.
limitations.text-properties: Property-bearing string storage and property inspection are not implemented.
limitations.unibyte: Distinct unibyte strings / Emacs raw-byte characters are not implemented.
limitations.extended-character: GNU non-Unicode character codes exceed the Unicode-only string substrate.
